When power returns

By v/hNovember 26, 2026Note

Originally shared
on LinkedIn

View the post ↗← All journal entries

When the power comes back at 3 a.m., the lamp should stay off.

For the v/h lamp, our intended behavior is to wait for someone to use the physical switch. A power interruption should not lead to a startup flash or the resumption of an old automatic action.

The design should retain learned patterns through normal unplugging. If timing information is lost, timed assistance should pause while ordinary on/off use stays available. Nobody should need a phone to make the lamp usable again.

We would test power loss while the lamp is on, off and partway through a fade, then check the first moments after each restart. Remembering a routine and deciding whether to act on it need separate checks.

No physical prototype has been built yet. We still need to build and validate the restart behavior described here.
